description: This file defines a JSON Lines document loader class for a data processing pipeline, including methods for loading, parsing, and handling metadata from JSONL files, with support for external dependencies like lodash, langchain, jsonpointer, and Node.js fs/promises.

classes.name: Jsonlines_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a JSON Lines file loader with support for metadata extraction and document splitting.

classes.name: TextLoader
classes.description: A base class for loading text files or blobs into Document objects.

classes.name: JSONLinesLoader
classes.description: A class extending TextLoader to parse JSONL formatted data, extract content via JSON pointer, and handle associated metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader, reads files, splits documents if needed, and processes metadata.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the content from a file or blob and returns Document objects.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses raw text into structured documents with content and metadata.
